integrity: The exact proof includes terminal normal forms, a last-step-reversal lemma and polynomial comparison. Self-review only; no independent audit, external certificate or formal proof assistant.
scientific_limitations: First generalized Frobenius (at most one representation) for triples of successive centered squares and n≥3. Excludes n≤2, larger representation thresholds and other figurate families. Chatterjee–Narula 2025 full paper on the same generators was inaccessible; its public abstract covers ordinary Frobenius and genus, but hidden stronger statements cannot be excluded. The stated finite verifications are not infinite proofs.
title: First generalized Frobenius number for triples of consecutive centered squares
